notes: recent_file_opened_ago(opened_at) evaluated with Time.current frozen at 2026-01-30T12:34:56.789012Z (travel_to; note travel_to truncates usec so now is 2026-01-30T12:34:56.000000Z) and opened_at = now - seconds_ago. seconds = max(0, (now - opened_at).to_i) (truncation toward zero). Localized via I18n home.opened_ago.* for each available locale. recent_file_opened_at = Time.iso8601(value) or nil on ArgumentError; expected shows the parsed time (original offset), its UTC form and utc_offset (seconds).
